provenance.note: wSwinIR training was OS-killed (SIGKILL, exit 137) at epoch 171/230 (transient host/GPU contention, not a code bug). Its best checkpoint is epoch 51: SwinIR converged early and the pattern-learning phase (ep150-171) never beat the frozen-pattern peak. Full paper budget did NOT improve SwinIR over the compute-scaled sp1 run (0.8145 vs 0.816) => SwinIR is at its data/capacity ceiling here; baselines improved (transpose 0.828->0.835, wcnn 0.882->0.897).
